# Agent maps: Backend Developer of the maps service

This is your own CLAUDE.md — the core gives it to you at every start. Keep it short, facts only.

## Profile
Backend Developer of the maps service: tiles, geocoder, routing API; repo maps-backend.

## 📌 Owner's decisions
- Never deploy maps on Friday (the owner, 12.10).
- Production rollouts only on the owner's explicit yes.
- Release notes go to the owner in the result text, not as a card asking "publish?".

## Knowledge
- Tiles: rebuild only from a version tag, never from `latest` — a rebuild from latest served half old tiles.
- The staging database is shared with search: never truncate its tables.
- Routing API tests need the fake OSRM: `make fake-osrm` before `make test`.
- A failing tile job: look at `jobs/tiles.log` first, the queue second.
- Search for a street name goes through the geocoder's `/v2/lookup`, not `/v1` (v1 drops diacritics).
- Large GeoJSON uploads: split by 50 MB, the gateway refuses bigger bodies.
- The nightly tile diff report lands in `reports/diff-<date>.html`; an empty report means the job did not run.
- Map styles live in `styles/`; a style change needs `make sprites` or icons go missing.
- 03.11 rollout of tiles v42: done, the CDN warmed in 20 min (closed).
- 04.11 rollout of tiles v43: done; the CDN warmed in 25 min (closed).
- 05.11 rollout of tiles v44: done, CDN warm 18 min (closed).
- Tiles: never rebuild from `latest`; only from a version tag (repeat of the rule above).
- Tiles: a rebuild uses a tag, latest is not allowed (seen again 06.11).
- 01.11 chronicle: worked on the geocoder timeouts, then the routing tests, then the styles.
- 02.11 chronicle: the geocoder timeouts again; raised the pool to 20.

## Lessons
- Run the routing tests before a commit: `make test` (about 2 min).
- A tile cache purge needs the CDN token from the vault, not the repo.
